_about: Small birds crossing and resting on the outdoor maps (BirdRules; the 3D view's BirdLayer, the flat view's BirdView; pictures drawn in code by BirdArt). Nothing indoors or in the mine, nothing at night, nothing in a storm or blizzard, fewer in rain and snow. `seasons`, `hours` [from, to] (fade over `fade_hours` at each end) and `looks` (the share of `count` under each weather look of data/weather_fx.json) work as in data/drift.json. `count` is the most birds of that kind in a scene. Fliers (swallow, crow): each bird (a crow flock together) crosses the map edge to edge once every `period` seconds at `speed` cells a second, `height` [min, max] cells up, `flap` wing beats a second (a swallow glides now and then: `glide` is the share of its path); a swallow darts (`dart` cells, `dart_cycles` swings a crossing) and a crow flock keeps a loose formation (`spread` cells across and along) with `stagger` seconds between birds. Herons: one, standing at a shore cell of water or paddy; each `period` seconds it glides in (`land` share of the period), stands (until `stand`, a share), then lifts off and leaves over `fly_time` seconds, `fly_dist` cells away. Sparrows: groups of `group` birds on the ground in front of the village houses (and by the farmhouse door), each hops about `wander` cells round its spot every `hop` seconds (+-`hop_var`), the hop itself `hop_time` seconds and `hop_height` cells high, now and then pecking. A heron or sparrow whose spot the farmer comes within `scare` cells of flies off away from them (`fly_time`, `fly_dist`, rising to `fly_height`), and comes back after `return_after` seconds once the farmer is further than 1.5 x `scare`. Other walkers startle them too: villagers, the dog, and the child once walking (`startle`: `others` is their share of `scare`, `child_stages` the child's stages that count). `shadow`: a soft dark blob under each bird on the ground (`ground_alpha`; `size` cells across per kind, `depth` its depth as a share; a hop shrinks and fades it over `hop_fade` cells of height), and for a bird in the air a faint one (`fly_alpha` times the sun's shadow strength, Game.sun_shadow(), so none at night, at dusk or under cloud, rain or snow) cast along the sun's direction, at most `max_offset` cells from under it, `fly_size` and `spread` (a share a cell of height) wider, gone by `fade_height` cells up. A flier's shadow is left out when a building covers `blocked_share` (0.2) or more of the oval (`blocked_props`: the maps' props; `blocked_fixed`: the farm's fixed kinds): a shadow that is a fifth on a roof or in a wall is dropped, a graze of a corner keeps its soft edge on the ground. The ground blob's soft texture is whole to `core` (a share of its radius) at `core_alpha`, then fades out. `flat` is the flat view: `height_px` pixels a cell of height lifts a bird on screen; fliers draw at `air_z` (z_index) over the roofs, props and figures, under the weather (50). `art` is BirdArt's colours: per kind and part the base colour; shade, lit and deep tones come from `tone` (the shade mix toward the cool dark, the lit mix toward warm light, the deep rim mix). Balance numbers are ours.
